headline: Manufacturing: “Gas Pedal” on Orders and Hiring – Greek Companies’ Optimism at a 2.5-Year High
summary: Greece's manufacturing sector continued its upward trend in August, with new orders and employment growing further. The seasonally adjusted PMI data are from S&P Global.
why: The Purchasing Managers' Index is a monthly survey of manufacturing activity, and readings above 50 signal expansion. It is closely watched as an early indicator of economic momentum.
